title: de.hubtask.jumble.entry.converted.v1
description: A jumble entry became work: a conversion produced an item at a named destination, recorded the provenance on both sides (the entry's target, the item's origin_jumble_id), and settled the entry as PROCESSED - once; a second conversion of the same entry is refused. The wire format is a CloudEvent 1.0 in structured JSON (ADR-0007); the tenant, the actor and the causal chain travel as CloudEvents extension attributes. Single-value enums stand in for `const`, and bounds are stated in descriptions rather than as keywords: the contract test validates against this file with the subset of JSON Schema the project implements. Fields may be added; removing or reinterpreting one requires a .v2 delivered alongside .v1 for at least two minor releases (domain-model.md §4).

id.description: UUIDv7. Stable across delivery attempts, so a consumer deduplicates on it (at-least-once delivery).

source.description: The installation and the bounded context that produced the event.

actorid.description: Absent when the system itself acts. No label: an event leaves the installation, and a name is personal data a subscriber does not need in order to react (ADR-0018).

onbehalfof.description: The principal an automation rule or an agent runs as.

correlationid.description: Everything that came out of one original action carries the same value. A root event is its own correlation.

causationid.description: The event that caused this one. Absent for an action a person took.

causationdepth.description: Distance from the original action. The rule engine stops at 5 and marks the run ABORTED_LOOP (automation.md §2).

target_item_id.description: The item the conversion produced - the other half of the provenance pair.

collection_id.description: Where the item was created. Absent when the destination carries no collection.
